name: Ni Hsin Group Berhad
overview: 2026年，Ni Hsin Group Berhad 的 Electric Vehicles 板块与 Chongqing Qiulong 签订 SURRON 品牌电动摩托车 CKD 组装合作协议，并与 Apex Ventures 完成 MOU，由三家子公司担任企业代理，以在 Turkey 和中东推广及分销产品。同时，公司与 Dato' Sri Pua 的 Heads of Agreement 到期后不再延长，涉及拟议收购的事项终止。
overview_en: In 2026, Ni Hsin Group Berhad's Electric Vehicles segment entered into a CKD assembly cooperation agreement with Chongqing Qiulong for SURRON brand electric motorcycles, and completed an MOU with Apex Ventures under which three subsidiaries became corporate agents to promote and distribute products in Turkey and the Middle East. Meanwhile, the Heads of Agreement with Dato' Sri Pua expired and was not extended, terminating the proposed acquisitions.

actions.text_en: The Heads of Agreement with Dato' Sri Pua Tian Siong expired on 31 December 2025 and the parties decided not to extend it, terminating the proposed acquisitions.
